name: clock-buffer pin with no access point
provenance: picorv32 on gf180mcuD, reproduced on five different die / density / clock combinations while preparing this lab
end_of_log:
[INFO DRT-0199]   Number of violations = 0.
[INFO GRT-0012] Found 7 antenna violations.
Unable to repair all setup violations.
[ERROR DRT-0073] No access point for clkbuf_2_1_0_clk/I (gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__clkbuf_8).
[ERROR DRT-0073] No access point for clkbuf_2_2_0_clk/I (gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__clkbuf_8).
Error: drt.tcl, 122 DRT-0073
known_cause: CTS_APPLY_NDR 'half' puts a 2x-spacing non-default routing rule on clock nets. On this PDK that leaves the larger clock buffers' input pins without a legal access point. Setting CTS_APPLY_NDR to none fixes it.
what_does_not_fix_it: Restricting CTS to smaller buffers (clkbuf_1/2/4) was tried and fails the same way, so the cell is not the problem; the routing resource around it is. A larger die and a looser clock do not help either.

name: a constraint command the timer does not have
provenance: first hand-written SDC for picorv32 in this lab; failed nine seconds into the flow
end_of_log:
Linking design 'picorv32' from netlist…
Reading design constraints file at 'src/impl.sdc'…
Error: impl.sdc, 10 invalid command name "remove_from_collection"
[ERROR] Failed STA for the nom_ss_125C_4v50 timing corner
known_cause: remove_from_collection is a command of commercial timers. OpenSTA does not implement it. Nothing is wrong with the flow settings; the constraint file is written in the wrong dialect. Dropping the custom SDC and using LibreLane's built-in one (driven by CLOCK_PORT, CLOCK_PERIOD and IO_DELAY_CONSTRAINT) removes the problem.
what_does_not_fix_it: Any change to placement, clock-tree or routing settings.

name: two builds of the timer on the path
provenance: lab-2 top on the course image, with /foss/tools/bin ahead of /foss/tools/openroad-librelane/bin on PATH
end_of_log:
report_clock_min_period
CLK period_min = 16.54 fmax = 60.45
Writing SDF files for all corners…
Removing Clock latencies before writing libs…
Writing timing models for all corners…
Error 562: corner.tcl line 605, write_timing_model -corner is not a known keyword or flag.
[ERROR] Failed STA for the max_ss_125C_4v50 timing corner
known_cause: The image carries two OpenSTA builds. Version 3.1.0 renamed write_timing_model's -corner flag to -scene; LibreLane 3.0.2 still passes -corner and only the 2.7.0 build shipped beside openroad-librelane accepts it. LibreLane calls a bare 'sta', so whichever is first on PATH wins. Putting /foss/tools/openroad-librelane/bin first fixes it.
what_does_not_fix_it: Any flow setting. The line number is also a trap: the corner.tcl that ships with LibreLane is 404 lines long and never calls write_timing_model directly.

name: placement dies inside the resizer
provenance: designs/spm in this repository, branch at PL; reproduced twice — both failing settings had PL_TIMING_DRIVEN true, every passing one had it false
error: FlowException: OpenROAD.GlobalPlacement failed with an unexpected error.
known_cause: PL_TIMING_DRIVEN true makes global placement call the resizer between iterations. On this design the resizer aborts while buffering a high-fanout net (RSZ-2008, 'wire step options empty'), which is a tool failure, not a bad number. Setting PL_TIMING_DRIVEN to false avoids it; the other placement knobs are irrelevant.
what_does_not_fix_it: Changing the target density or the wirelength coefficient while leaving timing-driven placement on.
